title: Decide whether to flash the local v98 desk image
notes: On 2026-10-28 `recovery-taq102-v98-local-desk.img` (SHA256 `f46150b15f80dbd118d8291c637d6e5d12851571c84e720ed9ab742a5a8f507e`, in the gate3-build folder) was built by the v97 recipe from the v87 base with dmxdesk `main` at `ecdeb7a`, not a release: the core/platform split, the generic OSC adapter, split sections named in the pager, and the centred colour-hit bolt with a narrower GOLPES DE COLOR switch. Its VERSION names `ecdeb7a`, clean; its desk executable SHA256 starts `71c6e54806c845e2`. Nothing was flashed. Next: the owner reviews the desk on the Mac, then either a dmxdesk release (v0.1.11) is cut and pinned here, or this image is flashed as a trial with `tools/loader-watch.sh recovery <image>`.
resolution: Superseded by dmxdesk v0.1.11 and the v99 image (recovery-taq102-v99-desk.img, SHA256 0a02be0d...), flashed to boot and recovery on 2026-11-03 with both readbacks matching; see docs/journal.md.
